sources: https://floridardr.usedirect.com/FloridaRDR/rdr/search/place (PlaceId 21) and search/grid (facilities 51 Loop BCH, 53 Loop RIVR), the API behind https://reserve.floridastateparks.org/Web/#!park/21

values.note: $33 a night for an RV: the $26 campsite fee plus a $7 nightly utility fee for RV units (tent camping $26), plus tax and a nonrefundable $6.70 reservation fee. Florida residents 65 and over, or holding a Social Security or 100% federal disability certificate, get 50% off the base campsite fee. Day visitors pay $6 a vehicle to enter; fort admission is $2.50 a person. Read 2026-10-20.

fees.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/fort-clinch-state-park/hours-fees ('$26 per night plus tax, plus a nonrefundable $6.70 reservation fee and a $7 nightly utility fee for RV ... units') + Reserve Florida 'Starting at $26.00' on both loops, read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/fort-clinch-state-park/experiences-amenities-0#camping ('Each campsite has a fire ring, picnic table, potable water and a mixture of 30- and 50-amp electric hook-ups'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Both campgrounds have a dump station (free to registered campers), laundry machines and heated accessible bathrooms with showers; the Amelia River bathhouse is air-conditioned in summer.

69 campsites in two campgrounds: Amelia River (42 sites, shaded, near the river) and Atlantic Beach (21 RV and 6 tent-only sites among the dunes). Reserve Florida lists 64 bookable units; RV site lengths run 18-48 ft, most 40-47 ft.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/fort-clinch-state-park/experiences-amenities-0#camping + Reserve Florida search/grid for facilities 51 and 53 (VehicleLength per unit, max 48), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Reserve Florida (reserve.floridastateparks.org) or 800-326-3521. The park page says reservations open up to 11 months ahead; Reserve Florida, queried without a Florida-resident account, offered dates to 2027-08-20 (10 months) on 2026-10-20, consistent with Florida's shorter non-resident window. Its booking restrictions give a 1-night minimum and 14-night maximum for both loops.

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/fort-clinch-state-park/experiences-amenities-0#camping ('Reservations can be made up to 11 months in advance') + Reserve Florida search/place PlaceId 21 Restrictions (FutureBookingEnds 2027-08-20, MinimumStay 1, MaximumStay 14), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $33 ($26 + $7 RV utility fee) and the $6.70 reservation fee on the park's fee page. Added 30/50-amp electric and water at every site, showers/laundry/dump, 69 sites up to 48 ft, and booking on Reserve Florida (usedirect, not 'operator'), 11-month window, 14-night max. Not stated: sewer at sites, pull-throughs, season, fcfs.
